business_summary: Shandong Nanshan Aluminium Co.,Ltd. engages in the aluminum processing business worldwide. The company offers upstream products, such as power generation, alumina, aluminum alloy ingots, and aluminum foil, as well as downstream products, including aluminum sheets and strips, which consist of automotive sheets, aviation sheets, and can materials; and industrial and building aluminum profiles. It also engages in the production of various aluminum alloy hot-rolled coils and new alloy products; research and development of high-tech projects and technology transfer; sale of building materials; laboratory testing of materials and its products; processing and refining bauxite; medical business; research, development, production, and sale of aviation and aerospace components; and metal scrap and shavings processing. In addition, the company is involved in the recycling of industrial waste metals; sale of non-ferrous metal alloys; health consultation services, engineering management services, and human resource management services; non-ferrous metal milling; research, development, production, and sale of chlor-alkali chemical products; trade of chemical products; sale of photovoltaic power generation; and sale of metal materials and ores. Its products are used in aviation, automotive, rail transportation, shipbuilding, energy, petrochemical, container, industrial profiles, high-quality civil profiles, high-end system doors and windows, containers, food packaging, battery foil, and deep aluminum processing fields. The company was formerly known as Shandong Nanshan Industrial Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shandong Nanshan Aluminium Co.,Ltd. in March 2006. Shandong Nanshan Aluminium Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Longkou, China.
business_summary_ko: 산동남산알루미늄유한회사 전 세계적으로 알루미늄 가공 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 발전, 알루미나, 알루미늄 합금 잉곳, 알루미늄 호일과 같은 업스트림 제품과 자동차 시트, 항공 시트, 캔 재료로 구성된 알루미늄 시트 및 스트립을 포함한 다운스트림 제품을 제공합니다. 산업용 및 건축용 알루미늄 프로파일. 또한 다양한 알루미늄합금 열연코일과 새로운 합금제품의 생산에도 참여하고 있습니다. 첨단 기술 프로젝트의 연구 개발 및 기술 이전; 건축자재 판매; 재료 및 제품의 실험실 테스트; 보크사이트 가공 및 정제; 의료사업; 항공 및 항공우주 부품의 연구, 개발, 생산 및 판매; 금속 스크랩 및 부스러기 처리. 또한 회사는 산업 폐금속 재활용에도 참여하고 있습니다. 비철금속 합금 판매; 건강 상담 서비스, 엔지니어링 관리 서비스, 인적 자원 관리 서비스; 비철금속 밀링; 염소-알칼리 화학제품의 연구, 개발, 생산 및 판매; 화학제품 무역; 태양광 발전 판매
